Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan using Telegram protocol for encrypted communication
Steals user data from infected devices
Commands include PC info gathering, message box display, webcam snapshots, IP info, file download/upload, directory listing, file execution, screenshot capture, keylogging, self-destruct
No port forwarding required due to Telegram protocol
Uses Telegram bot token embedded in config for command and control
Attack Vector: Infection via payloads that connect to Telegram bot channel
Indicators of Compromise: Telegram bot token in config file
